needs_owner.title: 🚨 Give the agent a VALID Anthropic API key — the whole product is down without it
needs_owner.why: The ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in Vercel prod is an 11-char placeholder (a real key is ~108 chars, sk-ant-api03-...). The key in .env.local is full-length but REVOKED (401). Tested both directly against Anthropic = 401 invalid. Result: every generator (all 8 free tools, /api/v1, the MCP server) fails. This explains posts_generated=0. Fix: create a key at console.anthropic.com and paste it to the agent; the agent will add it to Vercel + redeploy.
needs_owner.value: Create at https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys -> paste the sk-ant-... key to the agent
needs_owner.where: Agent adds to Vercel prod ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + redeploys

needs_owner.value: Just sign in at github.com in the same Chrome profile, then tell the agent to continue.
